ex.en: We are not short of oil in this country.
This firm ranks second in the oil trade.
ex.zh: 這家公司在石油業排名第二。

ex.en: We'd like to order 18 tonnes of olive oil.
ex.zh: 我們想訂購 18 噸橄欖油。

ex.en: When are you finally going to oil your door?
ex.zh: 你到底什麼時候才要幫門上油？

ex.en: You should oil your bike chain regularly.
ex.zh: 你應該定期幫腳踏車鏈條上油。
